basic_details.job_title: APCRDA Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA), Amaravati, will engage two Assistant Directors-Strategy in its Strategy Division on a one-year contract at a consolidated remuneration of Rs.1.00 lakh per month. The candidate needs an MBA with relevant specialization, or a Master's Degree in a listed discipline, plus minimum 2 years of post-qualification professional experience. Applications are to be submitted online on https://crda.ap.gov.in in the careers tab from 26 November 2026 to 9 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About APCRDA
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority, Amaravati, issued this notification from its project office at 2nd, 3rd and 5th Floors, APCRDA Project Office, Rayapudi Post, Tulluru Mandal, Amaravati, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh – 522237. The notification is signed by the Commissioner, APCRDA. The post supports the Deputy Director in international partnership activities of the Strategy Division.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one post, Assistant Director-Strategy, with these requirements. Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialization; or Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification professional experience, including exposure to any one of: government liaison work, international programme coordination, or institutional/policy matters. Familiarity with documentation cycles (concept notes, progress reports). Experience with documentation, correspondence drafting, and stakeholder coordination in a formal/government or multilateral setting. The notice says these are assessed independently of sector background: Analytical ability: comfort working with data, spreadsheets and research material to produce clear findings. Problem-solving: resourcefulness in unblocking coordination and documentation issues without escalation. Communication: clarity and accuracy in drafting correspondence, notes and presentations in English. Diligence in follow-through and attention to detail. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs.1.00 lakh per month. The engagement is on contract basis for a tenure of one year. The requirement is stated as immediate, and the place of work is APCRDA, Amaravati, Guntur District.

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Assistant Director-Strategy Job Description
content_sections.text: Supports the Deputy Director in the operational execution of international partnership activities, managing communications, documentation, coordination logistics, and follow-ups with international stakeholders and in the institutional matters. Draft and manage correspondence, notes and briefing material for international stakeholder engagement. Coordinate logistics for delegation visits, meetings and site visits (itineraries, running orders, protocol). Track action items and follow-ups from partnership meetings (e.g., MoU implementation, joint working groups). Document and research institutional arrangements for urban governance. Assist in preparing presentations, technical notes and progress reports for donor reviews. Liaise with internal departments to gather inputs needed for reporting and compliance. Maintain a repository of agreements, correspondence and partnership documentation. Provide administrative and analytical support during negotiations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APCRDA Assistant Director-Strategy
content_sections.text: Go to the APCRDA website https://crda.ap.gov.in . Open the careers tab, where the online application is available. Submit the application between 26 November 2026 and 9 December 2026. The notice says applications received through any other source or mode will not be processed. It names no documents to attach. For contact, the notice prints the phone number 0863-2000253 (10:00 a.m to 5:00 p.m. on working days) and the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts is subject to variation based on project requirements. APCRDA reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all of the notified posts. APCRDA reserves the right to amend, modify, withdraw or cancel the notification, either in whole or in part, without assigning any reason. Apply through the APCRDA website only; applications received through any other source or mode will not be processed.
